maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from POS/commerce software subscriptions, payments and hardware sales plus services; not primarily repair of installed base.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private retailers, restaurants and convenience/fuel businesses paying for POS software, payments and hardware.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own platform software and services; it has been divesting (sold digital banking), not roll-up acquiring.

mission_critical.reason: POS, payments and self-checkout run store and restaurant operations; switching means re-deployment, retraining and downtime risk.
